Package com.hiface.sdk.capture

Class FaceCaptureResult

java.lang.Object
com.hiface.sdk.capture.FaceCaptureResult
public final class FaceCaptureResult extends java.lang.Object
Immutable capture result with a 333 x 333 aligned preview and face feature. The host decides whether to store it. The feature string is not encrypted; the host manages protection of stored data.

  • Method Details

    • getAlignedFace

      @NonNull public android.graphics.Bitmap getAlignedFace()
      Return an independent 333 x 333 Bitmap aligned with five landmarks, with face-box expansion up to 1.30 times. Every call allocates approximately 433 KiB of new pixels without caching. The caller owns and releases the image when no longer needed. The result also retains an equally sized RGBA buffer; avoid retaining many results or repeatedly requesting images during batch processing.

    • getFeature

      @NonNull public java.lang.String getFeature()
      Return an SDK face-feature string. It can be used for dynamic 1:1 verification but is not encrypted text.
